notes.title: HappyFunTimes Shut Down
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37225519/6c28c39122d3dd57c94aa92015616e6ac34c3c43.png[/img]
​The plugin some of the games use to have phone controlled gameplay (HappyFunTimes) has shut down.

The affected games are:
[list]
[*]Discogreement
[*]Poll Plaza
[*]Red or Blue
[*]ULTIMATE CLIMAX BALL EXTREME
[/list]
These games are technically still playable in an extremely limited capacity by going to http://localhost:18679/​ while the game is running on the same machine the game is on, but it is no longer possible to connect multiple phones to play multiplayer.

They will remain in A Buttload of Free Games for the sake of preservation but sadly there's nothing that can be done to restore their former functionality.

A launcher update will be released soon that will label these games and provide instructions on how to play them solo locally.

notes.title: Big Update Soon
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37225519/8d5c9810e516a68f1ccdcf9e9367f21525b13c8b.png[/img]
Hey everyone, Sebastian here! I've been working on a completely rebuilt version of the launcher that will bring some major new features to A Buttload of Free Games!

Not wanting to spoil all the surprises, I will say that the biggest feature being added is Steamworks integration. This means that once Launcher 3.0.0 launches there will be Steam Achievements for the game(s)!

There is one small downside to adding achievements to a live product though: there will likely be a range of time where you will see the achievements live but be unable to obtain them. Just know that they will be accessible as soon as 3.0.0 launches, which there will be a major announcement for displayed in the game's spotlight. It'll be hard to miss! I just ask your understanding if there are a few hours between achievements going public and the new update launching where the achievements are visible but not unlockable.

There are a ton of other quality of life updates coming with the new launcher version as well as a couple surprises so look forward to it soon!

As thanks for reading all this here's a sneak peek at the visual revamp of the launcher:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37225519/b111f0d3dc85b744841544a3971a9f17c4107cd2.png[/img]

notes.title: 2 Years of A Buttload of Free Games
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37225519/6c28c39122d3dd57c94aa92015616e6ac34c3c43.png[/img]
Wow! 2 years already!

Thank you to everyone who's taken the time to check out all the games in this collection!

To celebrate 2 years, I've got some special beta access for everyone to check out!

You can now try out a legacy release of A Buttload of Free Games by entering the beta code "[b]buttloadlegacy[/b]". Doing so will take you back to the initial release of A Buttload of Free Games! It's wild to see how far the launcher has come since then and how many games have been added since!

If you're more inclined to look forward, you can also enter the beta code "[b]buttloadbeta[/b]" to access a public beta version of A Buttload of Free Games. This may get you access to new games a few days earlier than the usual public version, but expect more bugs in return!

You can enter the beta codes in the properties window for the game. Simply right click and select properties, then tab over to betas and enter away!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37225519/c0e276d322ccaee33c7436406b95784a91f1e9a5.png[/img]

Here's to another year of A Buttload of Free Games!

- Sebastian Scaini

Wow, a year has passed already since A Buttload of Free Games dropped on Steam!

To celebrate, the game will be 100% off for the weekend!

Tricked ya! It's always free!

But for real, thanks to everyone for their love, support and hatred of A Buttload of Free Games! We've got some fun additions on the way for 2021 so look for ward to those!

Here's to another Buttload of Free Games over the next year!

- Sebastian Scaini

notes.title: Launcher 2.0.0
notes.content:
A Buttload of Free Games Launcher 2.0.0 is available now! This major update brings new UI art by Del Nordlund, new sounds by Patrick Flattery and many much needed quality of life changes!

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added sound effects to launcher buttons.
[*] Added a settings screen and sound settings.
[*] Added new button art.
[*] Added launcher credits.
[*] Prevented opening multiple Before You Play windows at once.
[*] Prevented Before You Play windows from opening the wrong game should the game be changed before it is closed.
[*] Added short descriptors to each game.
[*] Added a Before You Play popup to Sqaranch!
[*] Redesigned launcher layout.
[*] Updated launcher intro scene.
[/list]

notes.title: Feature Requests
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I've made a thread in the discussions section for feature requests and bug reports for the launcher! If you have any thoughts about what you want to see in the launcher, drop them there! I am listening and am doing everything I can to make the launcher experience as good as it can be for everyone!
